comparator.name: Public Administration and Organization Science (Bestuurs- en Organisatiewetenschap)
comparator.academicYear: 2026–2027; adopted OER and exact annual project/practicum pages checked 26 October 2026
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted 2026–27 OER annex III specifies ten 6-EC first-year modules, eight 6-EC compulsory second-year Besturen modules plus two separate 6-EC Social Sciences for Society restricted choices, and third-year 30 EC genuinely open profiling space, 6 EC Besturen van de samenleving, 12 EC empirical research practicum, and 12 EC independent bachelor project. The first officially listed choice is instantiated in each separate restricted slot. Zero-credit mentorship and diagnostic language assessment do not contribute to the 180 EC. The 2026–27 regulations replace older bachelor-workgroup modules and EU Governance / Recht voor besturen en organiseren titles, so historical charts are not carried forward. Re-audit verifies the same 24-component180EC Besturen pathway and neutral official-order route choice. Research-practicum entry follows participation in Quantitative Methods; bachelorproject entry requires passed Governance or Consultancy Practicum and90EC from Years1–2. The bachelorproject is an individual academic paper and oral theoretical/methodological defense of results generated in the group research practicum, not a second independent empirical project. Year3 mentorship completion conditions project grade award. The Dutch diagnostic/remedial language sequence is part of Academic Skills and must be passed before its grade is awarded; no extra EC. Mandatory tutorials/practicals and elective-level/approval rules apply.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest public-governance route, the workplace change and digital-organisation route, and the climate-governance route arise from separate target-specific interest clusters and organise study around different questions. Each has a coherent 24-course curriculum, passes feasibility, and differs from each other by at least ten courses. Three is the maximum. Re-audit retains three only after actual-content/weight review: the organizational option removes literary stylistics and creative poetry/performance, adds ethical and emotion-theory foundations, and uses modern sociology before advanced civil-society study. The climate option is a distinct combined domain-science/public-governance pathway, not an assertion that chemistry or energy engineering replaces administration. No specific merger, HR credential, clinical, teacher or digital-society master outcome is guaranteed.

notes.text: The VU route integrates public administration and organizational science with a dedicated methods sequence, Governance Practicum, client-based team research and an individual academic paper and defense. UCR offers substantial related disciplinary study, but does not automatically reproduce that complete professional and research sequence. Literary production, emotion theory and environmental technologies are not substitutes for it.

The climate alternative deliberately combines environmental science and technical options with social, legal, economic and governance study. Its materials, resource and energy courses supply domain knowledge rather than public-management methods. Optional independent research is additional to the displayed 180 EC and requires separate approval; it is not automatically the VU practicum or bachelor project.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Public Administration and Organization Science studies how governments, businesses and civil society make decisions, organize people and implement change. The Dutch bachelor combines political and organizational analysis, law, economics, communication and social research. This comparison shows the Besturen route, its open study space and linked team-research and individual-project sequence.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers three qualified directions: public governance and policy; organizational leadership and responsible decisions; and climate science with public governance. Each has a substantial social-science response to the field, with different priorities. Leadership uses specific ethical and emotion-theory foundations; the climate direction includes substantial scientific and technical study. These do not confer the same disciplinary degree, specialist practicum, independent research sequence or automatic postgraduate eligibility.

curriculum.routeLabel: Besturen; first-listed route, two selected restricted choices
curriculum.limitation: The Dutch, full-time 2026–2027 bachelor is shown through Besturen, the first officially listed of two equally representative routes; Organiseren is not combined with it. The 24-component pathway contains 60 EC compulsory Year 1 study, 48 EC compulsory Year 2 study and two separate 6 EC restricted choices, then 30 EC open profiling, a 6 EC governance unit, 12 EC team research and a 12 EC individual bachelor project. Beyond Gender Inequalities and AI & Society are the first-listed choices in their respective slots. Qualitative Methods 2 follows participation in Methods 1; quantitative methods follow participation in descriptive/inferential statistics; the research practicum follows participation in quantitative methods. The bachelor project requires at least 90 EC from Years 1–2 and a passed Governance or Consultancy Practicum. It develops an individual academic paper, theoretical/methodological reflection and oral defense from the team-practicum findings. Tutorials are mandatory; group allocation is arranged by the coordinator. The research practicum assesses a group proposal/report and individual professional skills/reflection. Year 3 mentorship must be complete before the bachelor-project grade is awarded. Mentorship in all three years adds no separate EC. The mandatory Dutch diagnostic and any required refresher/remedial course must be passed as part of Academic Skills before that course receives a grade, without extra EC. BSA ordinarily requires 42 EC of first-year courses, subject to exceptions. Practicals and tutorials require attendance. Open choices normally exclude level 100 study and need at least 12 EC at level 300 and board approval; a single 6 EC level 100 prerequisite may be approved within a coherent package. Listed faculty electives and eligible university/listed minors are exempt from prior board approval; the Sociology minor requires an approved replacement for overlap. Internships require prior programme-stage-coordinator approval. Older replaced units and the two route charts are not stacked.
